decisions.name: Iodine
reasons: no USDA value; 5 measured source(s) available

decision.comment: Validated 2026-08-31: adopted US FDA TDS 0.6 µg (Iodine DB R4, green beans fresh/frozen boiled, SD 0.7; cooked-frame caveat). Band 0.6-2 across tables: FCDB 0.8 (1982 Danish), AFCD 1, CoFID 2 (UK feed-iodine high), MEXT trace.
decision.resolution: Override machine median pick 0.8 (1982 Danish) -> 0.6 US TDS per the region rule - exactly how zucchini 10056's iodine was chosen; practical difference nil, US-datum consistency governs. Approved by Shahab 2026-08-31. PROVENANCE FIX 2026-08-31: the machine's proposed FCDB stats (n=4, 0.6-1.3) had survived the value override - replaced with TDS's own n=35 (its 0.0-2.6 range is LOD-censored, not stored); FCDB's dispersion stays banked in intl_cv_observations.
